import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    h = 31.4*params[0]*eps*np.exp(-0.756*params[1]*eps)/T
    k = 0.0506*params[5]
    g = params[2] + params[3]*T + params[4]/(1+k*T) + params[6]*T**(1.273*params[7])*np.log(T)
    return h + g
